landing.welcome.title: Welcome to the Scylla devblog!
landing.welcome.body: We started this devblog because we believe in building in the open. You'll find updates on where the project stands, what we're working on, and where we're headed. We want your feedback, and we want you to be part of the conversation as Scylla takes shape.
landing.scylla.title: What is Scylla?
landing.scylla.body1: An open-core CI platform, delivered as a PaaS and deployable anywhere. A real alternative to tools where cost or lock-in make the decisions for you.
landing.scylla.body2: We focus on ease of use, support for applications at any scale, and high performance.
landing.posts.title: Latest Posts
about.title: About Scylla
about.body1: Scylla is an open-core continuous integration platform built to be delivered as a PaaS and deployable anywhere. The goal is straightforward: offer a genuine alternative to platforms where pricing is too aggressive, or vendor lock-in end up driving your decisions.
about.body2: The project is still early, and there's a lot of ground to cover. If you'd like to follow along, the devlogs on the home page are the best place to stay up to date.
about.body3: More storytelling about the why and how of Scylla will be coming in here and in future devlogs.
